subject: Marketplace seller migration created split charges and payout holdback - reconciliation request
messages:
From: Billing Ops <billing@cloudops.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: 2029-04-18T15:14:00Z
Subject: Marketplace seller migration caused split charges, payouts withheld - urgent reconciliation request

Hi Stephanie,

We discovered an issue after our SellerID migration on 2029-04-01. AWS has started routing a subset of metered lines to the old seller account which triggered a withholding on our April payouts (approx. EUR 42,300). Attached is a small migration_manifest.csv showing the affected merchant IDs and example invoice lines.

What we need from Redwood:
- A reconciliation of usage lines you received attributable to CloudOps for the period 2029-04-01 -> 2029-04-10
- Any evidence Redwood can provide to AWS to link the old seller lines to the new SellerID (merchant_id mapping, subscription ids)
- A timeline for when withheld funds can be released (our payroll is impacted)

I'm copying our finance lead Carolyn Wu. Can we get an initial reply by EOD tomorrow?

Thanks,
Carolyn Wu
Billing & Operations
CloudOps Inc.
attachments: migration_manifest.csv (CSV, 12 rows)

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>
To: Billing Ops <billing@cloudops.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2029-04-18T16:03:00Z
Subject: Re: Marketplace seller migration caused split charges, payouts withheld - urgent reconciliation request

Hi Carolyn / Billing Ops team,

Thanks for the note — sorry to hear payroll is affected. We'll take ownership on the reconciliation with the marketplaces. Initial plan:

1) Redwood will produce a usage reconciliation workbook showing all marketplace-metered lines we accepted for your account during 2029-04-01 -> 2029-04-10.
2) We'll map subscription IDs / order ids to the merchant_id rows you sent. Please confirm the mapping column names in your manifest (current_merchant_id, new_merchant_id, subscription_id).
3) I'll escalate to AWS Marketplace through our channel and request a provisional credit while they triage the SellerID routing.

Karthik and Monica are looped on finance and legal signoff for any attestation AWS requires.

Can you also drop the HubSpot deal ID or our invoice numbers that should receive the credit? That will speed application on our side.

Best,
Stephanie Nguyen
Head of Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
Phone: +1 415-555-0134
attachments: redwood_recon_template.csv (template)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>, Billing Ops <billing@cloudops.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2029-04-19T09:28:00Z
Subject: Re: Marketplace seller migration caused split charges, payouts withheld - reconciliation plan and ask

Carolyn / team —

I pulled the first pass of usage from our billing pipeline and started a reconciliation workbook (attached: rdw_recon_workbook.xlsx). Early observations: several metered lines show identical order ids but are attributed to two different merchant_ids (old and new). That signals a seller-side migration event on the marketplace.

Requests from our side:
- Please confirm the exact merchant_id values you expect us to reclassify to the new SellerID (column "new_merchant_id").
- Confirm the legal entity for VAT purposes for the new SellerID (we need to ensure credits are applied to the same taxable entity).
- Approve Redwood to share the attached workbook (redacted) with AWS Marketplace support so they can tie lines to the migration.

Action items:
- I will open/escalate a case with AWS Marketplace and provide them the workbook + your manifest.
- If AWS requires an attestation from CloudOps, Monica will advise on wording.

Next steps: Carolyn, if you can reply with the merchant_id mapping and entity name we'll forward to AWS today.

-Karthik
Director, Billing Operations
Redwood Inference
attachments: rdw_recon_workbook.xlsx (workbook, 9 sheets)

From: AWS Marketplace Support <aws-marketplace-support@amazonaws.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Billing Ops <billing@cloudops.com>
Date: 2029-04-20T11:47:00Z
Subject: Re: Case 987654321 - SellerID migration split lines / provisional credit update

Hello Redwood and CloudOps teams,

Thank you for the files. Case 987654321 has been assigned to our billing investigations team. Preliminary findings: the migration created duplicate metered line attributions for a subset of transactions (approximately EUR 42,318). AWS will issue a provisional adjustment to the affected reseller payout pending your attestation that the lines belong to the new SellerID.

Required from CloudOps (per AWS process):
- Signed attestation on letterhead specifying the SellerID change date and confirming the invoice lines in the submitted manifest belong to the new SellerID.
- Confirmation of the entity name and VAT registration number for the new SellerID.

We will schedule a provisional credit for the merchant in the coming 7-10 business days once the attestation is received and will update case 987654321. Attached is a draft provisional credit memo for reference (aws_adj_987654321.pdf).

Link to case: https://console.aws.amazon.com/support/cases#/case/987654321

Regards,
AWS Marketplace Billing Support
attachments: aws_adj_987654321.pdf (provisional credit memo)

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>
To: Billing Ops <billing@cloudops.com>, AWS Marketplace Support <aws-marketplace-support@amazonaws.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2029-04-22T09:02:00Z
Subject: Re: Case 987654321 - SellerID migration split lines / provisional credit update

Thanks all — quick summary and next steps so we have a single source of truth:

- CloudOps to sign and return the attestation confirming SellerID migration and VAT entity (CloudOps_signed_attestation.pdf attached).
- AWS has provisionally agreed to an adjustment and will post a provisional credit within 7-10 business days after receiving the signed attestation. AWS case 987654321 will be updated with the memo (aws_adj_987654321.pdf).
- Once AWS posts the credit, Redwood will apply the credit to CloudOps' open invoice(s) and release any Redwood-held funds to the CloudOps merchant settlement. We will confirm dates in a follow-up.
- Karthik / Monica: please keep Legal/Finance on the loop for the attestation wording; Monica please confirm whether a separate VAT invoice is required or if the credit memo is sufficient for EU VAT reclaim.

Carolyn — let us know when you upload the signed attestation and the VAT registration number. We will then finalize the submission to AWS and monitor for the provisional posting.

Appreciate the quick responses here — will follow up as soon as we see the provisional credit hit.

Best,
Stephanie Nguyen
Head of Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
attachments: CloudOps_signed_attestation.pdf, final_credit_memo.pdf
